material.acceptance_criteria: After stage.sh runs on the current working tree, the file served from .dev-site/ for ui_minimap.js is byte-identical to the working-tree ui_minimap.js, and the server answers the edited bytes.
material.description: Found while resolving gm-friction-minimap-witness-drain-gui-minimap-1 (item 3). The localhost witnesses ran stale code: the server answered ui_minimap.js at 7079 bytes, the pre-edit size, while the working tree held the edit. The server serves .dev-site, which stage.sh lays out (docs/QUICKSTART.md, docs/DEVELOPMENT.md:17 'Serves .dev-site on http://localhost:8790'), so the served file is a staged copy that the working tree edit never reaches until it is staged again. No gm verb starts or serves port 8790 (codesearch of /workspace/gm for 8790 finds no server), so the cause is on the oscraft side, not in gm. Not fixed in this row: no localhost use in that lane. Witnesses went through raw.githubusercontent at the pushed sha instead.

notes.note: Root cause: scripts/dev/stage.sh copies js/client with cp -r into .dev-site, so serve.mjs serves a snapshot; see row dev-serve-port-fixed-8790 for the layered-root fix.
